clue.text: Mad dog near bombed battleground …

indicators.note: something bombed is blown apart, so the letters of the three words before are scattered and reassembled

explanation.surface: A rabid dog loose near a bombed site, the scene running on into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links this clue to 2 Down for the surface only; each clue is solved on its own.
explanation.definitionFit: In Revelation it is the site of the final battle at the end of the world, so a battleground by name.

clue.text: … attracted attention, having set off but run away

indicators.note: away says the run is sent off, taken out of the phrase before it

parts.note: to strike out is to set off, as in striking out for home
R is the cricket scorer's abbreviation for a run

explanation.surface: Continuing the dog's story: it was noticed, having bolted off and run away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'run away' reads as one verb in the surface; here 'run' is R and 'away' removes it from STRUCK OUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that stands out conspicuously draws the eye, an idiomatic equivalent of drawing attention.

clue.text: Priest at home in nightclub

indicators.note: in places the home word inside the word for the nightclub

parts.note: a dive is a seedy bar or nightclub
in means at home, as in staying in

explanation.surface: A clergyman found relaxing at home inside a nightclub.
explanation.definitionFit: A divine is an old word for a clergyman or theologian, a noun sense beside the adjective.

clue.text: Kitchen equipment put together without reference to wife

indicators.note: without reference to says the wife is left out of the word before

parts.note: woven means put together from interlaced threads

explanation.surface: Assembling kitchen kit without consulting one's wife.
explanation.definitionFit: A cooker's enclosed baking compartment is a standard piece of kitchen equipment.

clue.text: Travelled between prospective southern terminals

indicators.note: between puts the travelling word inside, flanked by the two other pieces

parts.note: elect means chosen but not yet in office, as in president-elect
rode means travelled on horseback or by vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone shuttled between likely southern bus or rail terminals.
explanation.definitionFit: Electrodes are the conductors where current enters or leaves, the terminals of a battery or cell.

clue.text: Criminal turns — he's pursuing lady

indicators.note: criminal suggests something bent or wrong, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A crook changes direction because he is chasing a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A huntress is a woman who hunts, so literally a lady in pursuit of quarry.

clue.text: Rising international firm catching finest creatures in the sea

indicators.note: catching says the reversed pair holds the next piece inside it
in a down clue rising reads the letters upwards, so backwards

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
top means best or finest

explanation.surface: An ascending global company that has captured the best talent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rising' turns I and CO into OCI, which then catches TOP.
explanation.definitionFit: Octopuses are eight-armed molluscs living in the sea; the Latin-style plural is common in crosswords.

clue.text: Penny-pinching medium

explanation.surface: A spiritualist who won't spend a penny.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both stingy and the arithmetic average, two unrelated senses of one spelling.

clue.text: Rescue injured relative, overcoming resistance

indicators.note: overcoming is read as coming over, so the scrambled word sits around the resistance letter
injured means damaged, so the letters of the word are knocked out of order

parts.note: R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: Saving a hurt family member despite their reluctance.
explanation.definitionFit: Retrieval is the act of getting back or recovering something, close to a rescue.

clue.text: Kinsman from Paris one called regularly

parts.note: un is French for one

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of the word called

explanation.surface: A relative from Paris who phoned at regular intervals.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent's brother is a male relative, hence a kinsman.

clue.text: Publicly sell uniform used in battle

indicators.note: used in says the letter for uniform is placed inside the battle word

parts.note: action means fighting, as in killed in action
U is uniform in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: Selling off uniforms that saw service in war.
explanation.definitionFit: To sell goods to the highest bidder in a public sale is the verb sense.

clue.text: Butcher's attempt to get slimmer

definitions.meaning: to reduce one's eating, trying to lose weight

explanation.surface: A butcher trying to lose weight.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', joining the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to fell or kill and to reduce consumption, as in cutting back on food.

clue.text: Online information turned into lyric?

indicators.note: turned says the two pieces are read backwards

parts.note: E stands for electronic, online
dope is slang for information

explanation.surface: Internet facts reshaped into a song lyric.
explanation.definitionFit: An epode is a form of lyric poem, as in Horace's Epodes.

clue.text: Like a shrewd judge proceeding round diocese

indicators.note: round says the proceeding word goes around the diocese

parts.note: faring means getting on or proceeding
a see is a bishop's diocese

explanation.surface: A sharp-minded judge on circuit around a bishop's district.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone shrewd who judges well anticipates the future, being far-sighted.

clue.text: Dog clubs possibly go along with the rest

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them
clubs is one example of a suit in cards

explanation.surface: Hounding the clubs, perhaps, to fall in line with everyone else.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games one plays the suit led; the idiom means to conform to what others do.

clue.text: Commando short of experience joining engineers in punt

parts.note: green means inexperienced

indicators.note: in places the engineers inside the punt

parts.note: a punt is a bet
RE is the Royal Engineers

explanation.surface: A raw commando teaming up with engineers in a flat-bottomed boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'punt' suggests the boat but means a wager here.
explanation.definitionFit: Green Berets are special forces soldiers, so commandos by another name.

clue.text: Training aided the muscles, producing withering complaint

indicators.note: training shapes and reworks, so the letters are reorganised

explanation.surface: Gym work built up the muscles but left someone with a wasting illness.
explanation.definitionFit: This fungal disease kills elm trees, making their leaves wither: a plant ailment.

clue.text: Arab carrier?

parts.note: an Arab is a breed of horse, so its carrier is the vehicle for transporting horses, not an airline

explanation.surface: An airline from the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: A trailer or van for transporting horses carries an Arab, the horse breed.

clue.text: Rural tales a great success on two occasions

indicators.note: on two occasions says the piece appears twice

parts.note: a gas is something great fun, a hit

explanation.surface: Country stories that were hits twice over.
explanation.walkthrough: An Aga is a large range cooker; an Aga saga is a novel of middle-class English country life.
explanation.definitionFit: These are genre novels of comfortable English rural life, named after the cooker in their kitchens.

clue.text: Old port drunk by others, apparently with a bad reputation

indicators.note: drunk by says the old port is swallowed inside the others

parts.note: others are, apparently, those who are not us
Rio de Janeiro is a port, Rio for short

explanation.surface: Old port consumed by other people, seemingly ill-famed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'port' looks like the wine to be drunk; it is the Brazilian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Being well known for something bad is to be infamous.

clue.text: Pays for food after treasurer cleared out

indicators.note: after says the food comes after the treasurer's letters
cleared out empties the word, leaving only its outer letters

parts.note: eats is informal for food

explanation.surface: Someone foots the bill for food once the treasurer has emptied the coffers.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand someone a meal or drink is to cover its cost for them.

clue.text: Anticipating shower, daughter's run off

indicators.note: anticipating means coming before, so the daughter precedes the shower

parts.note: a shower is a spell of rain

explanation.surface: Expecting a downpour, a daughter has fled.
explanation.definitionFit: To drain is to let water flow away, to run off.

clue.text: Subs essentially contributing to benefit twice

indicators.note: contributing to puts the middle letters into the benefit word

parts.note: the dole is unemployment benefit

indicators.note: essentially takes the essence, the middle letters of the word

explanation.surface: Membership fees essentially helping a benefit to grow twofold.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb sense means in two ways or two times over, as in folded double.

clue.text: Could they make porter empty beer jugs?

indicators.note: an empty word keeps only its outer letters

parts.note: ewers are large jugs

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a hotel porter could drain jugs of beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'porter' reads as a hotel worker, but is the dark beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Porter is a dark beer, so those who make it are beer makers.

clue.text: Grain store (local name)

parts.note: the local is British slang for a neighbourhood pub, a bar

explanation.surface: A shop selling grain, with its local name in brackets.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'local' is British slang for one's nearby pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A farm building used to keep harvested crops is a grain store.

clue.text: Gallantry about data that shouldn't be asked of us ladies?

parts.note: C is circa, about

parts.words: data that shouldn't be asked of us ladies?
parts.note: the old etiquette rule is never to ask a lady her age, so ladies speak of our age

explanation.surface: Chivalry concerning a question one should never put to women.
explanation.definitionFit: Gallantry in battle is bravery, a synonym.

clue.text: Stand up for male of the species

definitions.meaning: to set upright, as of a dog's ears
a male bird, especially a rooster

explanation.surface: Defending the male sex.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to raise something erect and also names a male bird.

clue.text: Looking back is somewhat more troublesome

indicators.note: somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Nostalgia makes things a bit more awkward.
explanation.definitionFit: Retro style imitates the past, so it is backward-looking in fashion.

clue.text: Point the finger at inapt clue — revision needed

indicators.note: revision means reworking, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Blaming a clumsy crossword clue that needs rewriting.
explanation.definitionFit: To incriminate or accuse someone of wrongdoing is to blame them.
